Resolves #21428

The Web Desktop card's cover now shows the demo at work. Mail is open on its inbox with a message in the reading pane, beside the current launcher and taskbar. The old cover from 16 Nov showed the placeholder Mail card that #21414 retired. The file keeps its name, so `examples.json` doesn't change. The same bytes go to `neomjs/pages` in neomjs/pages#119.

The capture recipe now opens Mail as well. Its `after` check names `.neo-desktop-workspace`. The old `.webdesktop-workspace` went away when the workspace moved into `src/desktop` (#21348), so the recipe had been failing on `dev`.

Evidence: L2 (a recipe run through `captureExamples.mjs` and the catalog's unit specs, locally; the cover itself is a visual read) → L2 required (AC-1 is a visual read, AC-2 a hash, AC-3 a recipe run). Residual: the deployed cover, Residual-Owner: #21139.

Change class: restoration (`fix`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit and pre-push guards ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | Outside CI: the frames below. The new cover shows Mail's ten messages and its reading pane, the launcher's Communication, Media and Files groups, and the taskbar. There is no placeholder card and no Videos icon |
| AC-2 | Outside CI: `shasum -a 256` gives `9a8a5156459c77974269a99320eca70ad1ed242a9941ad400cfdb57f8cf93a9c` for both `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg` here and `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg` in neomjs/pages#119 |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --record webdesktop`, against a server on this branch, reports `captured`. Its `ready`, its sign-in and Mail steps and its `after` checks all pass. On `dev`, the stale `.webdesktop-workspace` failed after 15 s. `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` and the Portal examples controller spec: 60/60 |

## Deltas from ticket
- **A fourth fix.** The recipe's `after` selector was stale on `dev` (see above), so this PR also renames it.
- **The recipe does not make this cover.** Its 640 × 360 region at device scale 2 catches Mail mid-way through its open animation at the top left. A throwaway probe takes the cover, as for the first one in #21095: sign in, double-click Mail, drag its header to (385, 25), park the pointer at (300, 630), save a JPEG at quality 85, 1280 × 720 at scale 1.
